The *Sabbadāṭhijātaka* (Ja 241) is a narrative belonging to the Jātaka section of the Khuddaka Nikāya in the Pali Canon [SuttaCentral]. According to the narrative framework preserved in its commentary and recorded by SuttaCentral, the Buddha delivered this tale while residing at the Bamboo Grove (*Veḷuvana*), taking the conduct of Devadatta as the occasion for the discourse [SuttaCentral]. The story opens with the phrase "Even as the Jackal" [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records four translations across four languages for this text [SuttaCentral].
